questions.question: Dr. Taki, after 8 years of practice, wishes to run for the National Council elections. According to Article 21 of Law 07-05, what is the eligibility condition?
options: Be registered with the order for 5 years
Have practiced the profession for at least 8 years
Have been president of a Regional Council
questions.explanation: Article 21 provides that dental surgeons who have practiced the profession for at least 8 years at the date of their candidacy are eligible.

questions.question: Dr. Touitou, a member of the National Council, explains to Dr. Taki that according to Article 22, the term of office for members of the National Council is:
questions.explanation: Article 22 stipulates that members of the National Council are elected for four years.

questions.question: According to Article 22, can a member of the National Council be re-elected multiple times consecutively?
questions.explanation: Article 22 specifies that they can only be re-elected for a single consecutive term.

questions.question: Dr. Taki wishes to run for the Regional Council. According to Article 22, can he simultaneously hold functions on the Regional Council and the National Council?
options: Yes, if elected in two different regions
questions.explanation: Article 22 specifies that members cannot simultaneously hold functions on the National Council and the Regional Council.

questions.question: According to Article 20, who can vote in the National Council elections?
options: Moroccan dentists registered with the order and up to date with their dues
Dentists with more than 10 years of experience
questions.explanation: Article 20 provides that voters are Moroccan dental surgeons registered with the Order and up to date with their dues at the date of the elections.

questions.question: Dr. Taki wonders about the election date. According to Article 23, elections must be scheduled at least how many months before the end of the term?
questions.explanation: Article 23 provides that the date of elections is set at least 3 months before the expiration of the National Council's term.

questions.question: According to Article 23, candidacies must be filed with the President of the National Council at least how many months before the elections?
questions.explanation: Article 23 stipulates that candidacies must be filed with the President of the National Council at least two months before the date set for the elections.

questions.question: Dr. Touitou explains to Dr. Taki that according to Article 25, the National Council elections are held:
questions.explanation: Article 25 provides that the election of titular and substitute members of the National Council is held by uninominal and secret ballot.

questions.question: According to Article 25, in the event of a tie between two candidates, who is declared elected?
options: The most senior in the practice of the profession
The one with the most diplomas
questions.explanation: Article 25 provides that in the event of a tie, the most senior in the practice of the profession is declared elected.

questions.question: According to Article 28, how many public sector dentists sit ex officio on the National Council?
questions.explanation: Article 28 provides that six dental surgeons practicing in the public sector sit ex officio.

questions.question: Dr. Taki learns that according to Article 28, the ex-officio members are distributed as follows:
questions.explanation: Article 28 specifies the distribution: two from State services, two teacher-researchers, and two military dental surgeons.

questions.question: According to Article 30, the National Council sets the amount of members' dues as well as:
options: Their collection methods and the share allocated to Regional Councils
questions.explanation: Article 30 provides that the National Council sets the amount of members' dues as well as their collection methods and the share allocated to Regional Councils.

questions.question: According to Article 30, the National Council hears appeals against decisions of the Regional Councils regarding:
options: Discipline and registration with the order
questions.explanation: Article 30 provides that the National Council hears appeals against decisions of the Regional Councils in disciplinary matters and registration with the Order.

questions.question: Dr. Taki wants to understand the role of the legal advisor. According to Article 36, what can he do if the National Council exceeds its powers?
options: He can request a second deliberation
He can refer the matter to the Minister
questions.explanation: Article 36 provides that the legal advisor requests the president to submit the decision to a second deliberation.

questions.question: According to Article 38, a Regional Council is created in each region when the number of dentists reaches or exceeds:
questions.explanation: Article 38 provides that a Regional Council is created in each region when the number of dental surgeons practicing in the region is equal to or greater than 400.

questions.question: According to Article 39, how many members compose a Regional Council for a region with more than 800 dentists?
questions.explanation: Article 39 provides that the number of members to be elected is 8 when the number of dentists is greater than 800 and does not exceed 1200.

questions.question: Dr. Taki is elected to the Regional Council. According to Article 42, members of the Regional Council are elected for a term of:
questions.explanation: Article 42 stipulates that members of the Regional Council are elected for four years.

questions.question: According to Article 42, can a member of the Regional Council run for a second consecutive term?
questions.explanation: Article 42 specifies that they can only be re-elected for a single consecutive term.

questions.question: According to Article 48, the Regional Council hears registration requests with the Order. This is:
questions.explanation: Article 48 lists the attributions of the Regional Council, including hearing registration requests with the Order.

questions.question: According to Article 52, the Regional Council can only validly deliberate if more than half of its members are present. If the quorum is not reached, what happens?
options: A second meeting is convened 15 days later
questions.explanation: Article 52 provides that a second meeting is convened 15 days after the unsuccessful meeting, and the Council can then deliberate regardless of the number of members present.

questions.question: Dr. Taki encounters a problem with the functioning of his Regional Council. According to Article 53, if the Regional Council cannot function normally, the administration appoints:
options: The President of the National Council
questions.explanation: Article 53 provides that the administration appoints a commission composed of three eligible members to assume the Council's functions.

questions.question: According to Article 54, any violation of professional obligations is considered a disciplinary fault, including:
options: Violation of the rules of honor and probity
questions.explanation: Article 54 considers as a disciplinary fault the violation of professional rules and non-compliance with the rules of honor, probity, and dignity of the profession.

questions.question: According to Article 55, suspension as a disciplinary sanction cannot exceed:
questions.explanation: Article 55 provides that suspension cannot exceed one month.

questions.question: According to Article 56, a suspension may be suspended. In this case, it becomes enforceable if, within a period of:
questions.explanation: Article 56 provides that the sanction becomes enforceable if, within a period of four years, the dentist is subject to another disciplinary sanction.

questions.question: According to Article 58, disciplinary action is exercised in the first instance before:
questions.explanation: Article 58 provides that disciplinary action is exercised, in the first instance, before the Regional Council to which the dental surgeon belongs.

questions.question: Dr. Taki is summoned before the disciplinary council. According to Article 71, can he be assisted by a lawyer?
options: Yes, he can be assisted by a colleague or a lawyer
Yes, but only by a colleague
No, he must defend himself alone
questions.explanation: Article 71 provides that the dental surgeon concerned can be assisted, at all stages of the disciplinary procedure, by a colleague or a lawyer.
